symptoms: runny nose, sneezing, sore throat, mild cough, congestion, mild headache
description: A mild viral infection of the nose and throat. Usually resolves on its own within 7-10 days.
precautions: rest and stay hydrated, use saline nasal spray, gargle warm salt water, avoid cold drinks

symptoms: fever, chills, muscle aches, fatigue, dry cough, headache, sore throat
description: A contagious viral respiratory illness that is generally more severe than a common cold.
precautions: rest in bed, drink plenty of fluids, take fever reducers if needed, isolate from others, seek care if breathing difficulty occurs

symptoms: fever, dry cough, loss of taste or smell, fatigue, shortness of breath, sore throat
description: A viral respiratory illness caused by the SARS-CoV-2 virus, ranging from mild to severe.
precautions: isolate from others, monitor oxygen levels, rest and hydrate, seek emergency care if breathing becomes difficult

symptoms: severe one-sided headache, nausea, sensitivity to light, sensitivity to sound, visual aura
description: A neurological condition causing intense, throbbing headaches often with other symptoms.
precautions: rest in a dark quiet room, apply cold compress, stay hydrated, avoid known triggers, consider prescribed migraine medication

symptoms: dull aching head pain, tightness across forehead, neck stiffness, scalp tenderness
description: The most common type of headache, often linked to stress or muscle tension.
precautions: apply warm or cold compress, gentle neck stretches, manage stress, ensure adequate sleep

symptoms: diarrhea, abdominal cramps, nausea, vomiting, mild fever, dehydration
description: Inflammation of the stomach and intestines, often from viral or bacterial infection.
precautions: drink oral rehydration solution, eat bland foods (rice, banana, toast), avoid dairy and fatty foods, rest

symptoms: heartburn, regurgitation, chest discomfort, bloating, sour taste in mouth
description: A digestive condition where stomach acid frequently flows back into the esophagus.
precautions: avoid spicy and fatty foods, eat smaller meals, do not lie down right after eating, elevate head while sleeping

symptoms: nausea, vomiting, watery diarrhea, abdominal pain, fever, weakness
description: Illness caused by consuming contaminated food or water.
precautions: stay hydrated with electrolyte solution, rest, avoid solid food until vomiting stops, seek care if symptoms persist beyond 2 days

symptoms: burning urination, frequent urge to urinate, cloudy urine, lower abdominal pain, mild fever
description: A bacterial infection affecting any part of the urinary system, most often the bladder.
precautions: drink plenty of water, urinate frequently, avoid irritants like caffeine, complete prescribed antibiotics if given

symptoms: often no symptoms, occasional headache, dizziness, blurred vision, nosebleeds
description: A chronic condition of consistently elevated blood pressure that increases cardiovascular risk.
precautions: reduce salt intake, exercise regularly, manage stress, monitor blood pressure regularly, take prescribed medication consistently

symptoms: increased thirst, frequent urination, fatigue, blurred vision, slow-healing wounds
description: A chronic condition affecting how the body processes blood sugar.
precautions: monitor blood sugar regularly, follow a balanced low-sugar diet, exercise regularly, take medication as prescribed

symptoms: sneezing, itchy eyes, runny nose, nasal congestion, postnasal drip
description: An allergic reaction causing cold-like symptoms, usually triggered by pollen, dust, or pet dander.
precautions: avoid known allergens, use air purifiers, try antihistamines, keep windows closed during high pollen seasons

symptoms: wheezing, shortness of breath, chest tightness, persistent cough
description: A chronic respiratory condition causing airway inflammation and breathing difficulty.
precautions: use prescribed inhaler, avoid known triggers, monitor breathing, seek emergency care for severe attacks

symptoms: persistent cough, mucus production, fatigue, mild fever, chest discomfort
description: Inflammation of the bronchial tubes, often following a respiratory infection.
precautions: rest and hydrate, use a humidifier, avoid smoke and irritants, see a doctor if cough lasts over 3 weeks

symptoms: high fever, productive cough, difficulty breathing, chest pain, chills
description: An infection that inflames the air sacs in one or both lungs.
precautions: seek prompt medical attention, complete prescribed antibiotics, rest, stay hydrated, monitor oxygen levels

symptoms: facial pain or pressure, nasal congestion, thick nasal discharge, reduced sense of smell, headache
description: Inflammation of the sinus cavities, often following a cold or allergies.
precautions: use steam inhalation, saline rinses, stay hydrated, consult a doctor if symptoms last beyond 10 days

symptoms: red eyes, itchy eyes, watery discharge, gritty feeling, crusting of eyelids
description: Inflammation of the membrane covering the eye, often viral, bacterial, or allergic.
precautions: avoid touching or rubbing eyes, wash hands frequently, use clean compress, avoid sharing towels

symptoms: itchy skin, redness, dry patches, swelling, blistering in severe cases
description: Inflammation of the skin caused by irritants, allergens, or underlying conditions.
precautions: avoid known irritants, moisturize regularly, use mild soap, apply prescribed topical treatment

symptoms: fatigue, pale skin, shortness of breath, dizziness, brittle nails, cold hands and feet
description: A condition where the blood lacks enough healthy red blood cells due to insufficient iron.
precautions: eat iron-rich foods, take iron supplements if prescribed, pair iron with vitamin C for absorption, monitor with blood tests

symptoms: fatigue, weight gain, cold intolerance, dry skin, hair thinning, depression
description: A condition where the thyroid gland doesn't produce enough thyroid hormone.
precautions: take prescribed thyroid medication consistently, regular thyroid function tests, maintain balanced diet

symptoms: weight loss, rapid heartbeat, sweating, nervousness, tremors, heat intolerance
description: A condition where the thyroid gland produces excess thyroid hormone.
precautions: follow prescribed treatment plan, avoid excess iodine, manage stress, regular monitoring with doctor

symptoms: excessive worry, restlessness, muscle tension, difficulty concentrating, sleep disturbance, irritability
description: A mental health condition involving persistent and excessive worry about various aspects of life.
precautions: practice deep breathing and grounding techniques, maintain regular sleep schedule, limit caffeine, consider therapy (CBT)

symptoms: persistent sadness, loss of interest in activities, fatigue, sleep changes, appetite changes, difficulty concentrating
description: A mental health condition causing persistent feelings of sadness and loss of interest.
precautions: maintain daily routine, stay socially connected, gentle physical activity, seek professional therapy, reach out to support helplines if severe

symptoms: difficulty falling asleep, frequent waking, waking too early, daytime fatigue, irritability
description: A sleep disorder characterized by persistent trouble falling or staying asleep.
precautions: maintain consistent sleep schedule, avoid screens before bed, limit caffeine and naps, practice relaxation techniques

symptoms: dull or sharp ache in lower back, stiffness, muscle spasm, pain radiating to legs
description: A common musculoskeletal complaint often from strain, poor posture, or underlying spinal issues.
precautions: apply heat or ice, gentle stretching, maintain good posture, avoid heavy lifting, consult doctor if pain radiates down legs

symptoms: joint pain, stiffness especially in morning, swelling, reduced range of motion, grating sensation
description: A degenerative joint condition caused by the breakdown of cartilage over time.
precautions: stay active with low-impact exercise, maintain healthy weight, use supportive footwear, consider physical therapy

symptoms: high fever, severe headache, pain behind eyes, joint and muscle pain, rash, easy bruising
description: A mosquito-borne viral infection common in tropical regions, can range from mild to severe.
precautions: rest and hydrate well, monitor for warning signs (bleeding, severe abdominal pain), avoid aspirin/ibuprofen, seek medical care promptly

symptoms: prolonged high fever, weakness, stomach pain, headache, loss of appetite, rash
description: A bacterial infection spread through contaminated food or water.
precautions: seek medical treatment promptly, complete full antibiotic course, stay hydrated, eat easily digestible food, rest

symptoms: itchy rash with blisters, fever, fatigue, loss of appetite, headache
description: A highly contagious viral infection causing an itchy, blister-like rash.
precautions: avoid scratching, keep nails trimmed, use calamine lotion, isolate to prevent spreading, stay hydrated

symptoms: cyclical fever with chills, sweating, headache, muscle pain, fatigue, nausea
description: A mosquito-borne parasitic disease that can become severe without prompt treatment.
precautions: seek immediate medical testing and treatment, complete full antimalarial course, use mosquito protection, rest and hydrate
